label: Ititu
note: Built up in layers, not left in one batch.

about.text: A concentrated sour milk curd of the Borana of southern Ethiopia, built up in a smoked vessel over weeks by adding fresh milk and draining whey.

links.name: Karssa et al. 2024, Insights on the microbiology of Ethiopian fermented milk products

how.label: top up, drain whey
how.text: Ititu is concentrated by repeated topping up and draining, so it ends as a sour curd, not a drink.

links.name: Karssa et al. 2024, Insights on the microbiology of Ethiopian fermented milk products

Kassaye et al. 1991, Chemical and microbiological characteristics of Ititu

adds.vessel: gorfa, a pear-shaped container smoked with Olea africana

steps.note: Every 3–4 days whey is drained off and fresh milk added until the curd is thick.

processing.text: No starter; natural fermentation. Every 3-4 days whey is drained off and fresh milk added until the curd is thick; the Borana study gives 1 week to 3 months.
